definitions.explanation: dishes, pots, and utensils that need to be washed
clothes or items that need to be laundered

examples.japanese: {洗|あら}い{物|もの}がたまっている。
{食後|しょくご}の{洗|あら}い{物|もの}をする。
examples.english: To do the dishes after eating.

examples.japanese: {洗|あら}い{物|もの}は{食洗機|しょくせんき}に{任|まか}せている。
examples.english: I leave the dishes to the dishwasher.

examples.japanese: {洗|あら}い{物|もの}が{多|おお}いと{面倒|めんどう}だ。
examples.english: It's troublesome when there are a lot of dishes to wash.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}から{帰|かえ}ったら{洗|あら}い{物|もの}がいっぱいあった。
examples.english: When I got back from my trip, there was a lot of laundry.

examples.japanese: {洗|あら}い{物|もの}は{週末|しゅうまつ}にまとめてやる。
examples.english: I do the laundry all at once on weekends.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{続|つづ}いて{洗|あら}い{物|もの}が{乾|かわ}かない。
examples.english: The laundry won't dry because it keeps raining.

notes:
SENSE 1 - DISHES:
- More commonly used for dishes
- {洗|あら}い{物|もの}をする (to do the dishes)
- {洗|あら}い{物|もの}が{溜|た}まる (dishes pile up)

SENSE 2 - LAUNDRY:
- Also used for laundry, though {洗濯物|せんたくもの} is more specific

RELATED WORDS:
- {皿洗|さらあら}い (dishwashing)
- {洗濯物|せんたくもの} (laundry - more specific)
- {食洗機|しょくせんき} (dishwasher)

HOUSEHOLD TASKS:
- {洗|あら}い{物|もの}をする (wash dishes/laundry)
- {洗|あら}い{物|もの}を{片付|かたづ}ける (put away the washed items)
